name: 281 Hair
lead: A Glasgow city-centre salon for cuts, blow-drys and bespoke colour, with colour correction as our speciality. L'Oréal Professionnel, Olaplex, Milkshake and Wella.

experience.title: Total care for your hair
experience.text: Our experienced stylists offer everything from cuts and blow-drys to full-scale bespoke colour. Every new look starts with a free consultation, so the treatment suits you, and we go the extra mile to get you what you really want.

items: Full head tint with partial foils & blow dry
Short hair or pixie, full head bleach & tone

currency_note: 10% student discount on selected services. Prices may vary with length and thickness; colour starts with a free consultation.

special.title: Colour correction
special.text: Bespoke colour and colour correction are what we do best. Book a free consultation and we'll work out exactly what your hair needs before we start.

reviews: I had such a wonderful experience at 281 Hair and left feeling completely satisfied and genuinely happy with the results.  From the very beginning, Danni was fantastic.

Very happy with my first experience with this salon. Lesley spent the time getting to know what look it was I wanted to achieve & sat down with me to talk with me about what would suit my hair type & how i should care for it from now on to keep it in tip top condition.

I would give this salon more than 5 stars if possible!! Best experience!! Everyone is absolutely sweet and welcoming. Book your appointment you won’t be disappointed!!  I have never gotten my hair with permanent tint and had a consult with Beth prior to my appointment.
I had the most amazing experience at 281 Hair. It was my first appointment and Lesley could not have been more amazing.
address: First Floor, 281 Sauchiehall Street, Glasgow G2 3HQ
